steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Move out.

steps.name: L. G. D. Operator
steps.text: But we're really not familiar with the layout here. I'm worried... what if the Infected resist our operations?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Relax. I know the area. Just follow my orders.

steps.name: L. G. D. Operator
steps.text: Yes, Sir!

steps.name: L. G. D. Operator
steps.text: Sir, bad news: intelligence reports Reunion is moving with some degree of organization again. It seems they've found another commander.

steps.name: L. G. D. Operator
steps.text: And... and they've reencrypted their communication channels. We can't intercept them anymore!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Could they have joined up with the units in the slums?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Impossible. Rhodes Island should already have dealt with the situation there. There's no risk of us getting boxed in.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Strange...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah Ch'en, I'm ready to——

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A transmission?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Little Miss,' would you mind giving me the room?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How do you work it out so you're busy every time I have something for you?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Is that spy of yours back on the grid?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I said give me the room. And get me some finballs while you're out.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm not a kid, you know.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...This is Ch'en.
We have another Reunion element up from the lower levels of the slums.
Infected called Yeti Squad. It seems they have the ability to collapse buildings and destroy infrastructure.
Tread carefully.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Only-1, Lungmen's special forces are operating in the slums. We are at the moment incapable of stopping them. Exercise caution.
Roger.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Only-1, why did you drop out of contact?
I had some things on my mind.
It's clear to me now. I'm leaving Lungmen to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What? I don't understand.
Me, now? I don't belong here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Only-1!
I'm going to take some of Lungmen's Infected. The L. G. D. can't protect them. The city doesn't care about them.
In other words, this city isn't at all what you think it is.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nine! You're under orders!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I haven't been with the L. G. D. for over three years.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: And actually it was me giving orders to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nine...!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Those special forces you're talking about? I think I've seen them around.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I thought too much of this city. Goodbye, Ch'en.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Oh, right. Don't go snooping around the sewers.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Was I too loud?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're pretty loud. I think the whole block heard you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And yet I'm still not as loud as you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey, Ah Ch'en, get over here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Have a seat.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wow, Miss Swire squatting on a dirty street corner. You're not afraid to soil your clothes?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Certainly not! What makes you think I'd worry about a thing like that?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I was just about to give that stinky sewer rat another call.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I may not come here often, but I'm pretty sure those special forces are up to no good.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you met Lin? From the slums?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I have. He's a nice old man. Nicer than my grandpa anyway.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They call him the 'Rat King.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The men behind the curtain aren't all like such. But he's really a good person.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I never thought Yühsia would turn out like this. She was such a shy and timid girl, the kind who would always hide behind you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think she's changed. She just... took on responsibility. Maybe the kind she couldn't handle.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: It wouldn't do any good to tell her that. We're between a rock and hard place here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can't say I understand what's going on between her and her father, but I know she's not so cold-blooded.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: So I'm gonna call her.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That report I just got may be of use to us.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A Reunion group with special powers has entered the slums, and they're able to command other Reunion elements.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And I'm the only one who knows. Well, now it's the two of us, I guess.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We steer the raincoats into them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Aside from the group left to help the L. G. D. clean up the new-type Infected, there's also quite a few of those special forces with us in the slums.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And the situation is: we don't know their distribution, we have no way to guard against them, and have no idea what they might do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But with Lin Yühsia's help, we can guide them into that Reunion team.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Force them out? Show them to the whole L. G. D.?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L. G. D., sure, but also Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You trust them so much?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They chase their objectives harder than any group I've ever seen. They're even more dedicated than the L. G. D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And who else are we going to trust?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've got stones, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ordinary Lungmenites don't know Lin, they don't know your grandfather, they don't even really know Wei Yenwu, let alone any chambers of commerce or whatever behind the scenes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They just trust the L. G. D. None of those players would dare disband the L. G. D., and leave us with the regular old police.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then you add in the outsiders... And there's no way they'll want to take over.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They'll fire you though.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Whoop-de-doo.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Then let's wrap up this one last job! Next time, their patrol route goes right into the slums.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can get Lin on board?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: As long as we look after this place, Lin will work with us.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: One more thing...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you know we have three guests?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Listen up, stinky rat, I've got news for you. There's a Reunion unit we can't hold. We need your team's help.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Impossible. What are you trying to pull?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Have I ever lied to you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You said we'd go to the same secondary school, only for you to run off to Victoria.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm sorry. Really, truly sorry.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Forget it. I don't care.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yühsia, your dad has done so much for Lungmen. We don't want to lose this place, and the people here can't lose us either.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Liar. You're coming here?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You'll come to the slums?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ......Ch'en will.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You really are a terrible liar. What business have I with her?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: For whatever reason, your dad wasn't able to resolve the conflict between the Infected and the normal people, but Ch'en can.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ch'en and your father will rebuild the slums together.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They're working to turn it into a place where all kinds of people can live, to the point that we won't even be able to call it the slums anymore.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Think about it... Even though most Lungmenites don't live here, they've been coming here a lot in the past few years, haven't they?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Soon, we won't need any slums.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We haven't been able to solve the Infected crisis, but I know... We can make this a better place.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They'll be Lungmen's downtown Districts 22 to 29. No longer 'slums.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This city was built on the many, many different kinds of people all coming together to make it what it is today.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Lungmen can't afford to lose anyone.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Yawn. How boring. You've become as boring as Ch'en.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yühsia...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Look, I'm not trying to make a soap opera here.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Where is that Reunion unit?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I won't ask again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya, have you entered the slums?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We have a bit of a situation here. Let me fill you in.
